claims.claim_text: 一份 2026 年的 WebAssembly runtime 效能橫評，把目前主流的 server-side wasm runtime 放在同一組工作負載下實測比較
claims.note: Source 00f.net returned HTTP 403/503 (anti-bot); Wayback unreachable. Not verified from own knowledge. Lede deliberately written with no specific numbers (hedged). Medium-load → accepted-with-flag.

claims.claim_text: 與其在收下 email 前先驗證它存不存在，作者主張直接寄一封確認信、點了連結才算數；批評 Pangram 主動批量寄信探測會害自己上 SPAMRATS、Barracuda 黑名單
claims.evidence: Generally accepted advice is that you should just send verification link and don't care about trying to validate it beforehand. (+ Pangram critique, SPAMRATS/Barracuda blacklist)

claims.claim_text: Baidu 開源 Unlimited-OCR，主打 one-shot long-horizon parsing，context 開到 32768 token；多頁文件與 PDF 走專門的 infer_multi 路徑，單張影像有 gundam 與 base 兩種設定，可在 Transformers 與 SGLang 上跑；自陳把 DeepSeek-OCR 再推一步，權重與論文 arXiv 2606.23050 已放出
claims.evidence: model.infer() for single image; model.infer_multi() for multi page / PDF only; context-length 32768; gundam/base configs; Transformers + SGLang; 'aiming to push Deepseek-OCR one step further'; arXiv:2606.23050; weights at baidu/Unlimited-OCR.
claims.note: Round-1 flagged the original lede's '單次 forward 就能解析' as an inflated/unverifiable causal overclaim (the repo has a SEPARATE infer_multi() for multi-page/PDF). FIXED in round-2: lede rewritten to attribute 'one-shot long-horizon parsing' to the project, scope single-pass to long documents, and state infer_multi handles multi-page/PDF. The corrected lede now asserts only round-1-verified facts.

claims.claim_text: 歷時六年、超過 360 個 patch，Linux 7.2 成為第一個徹底移除 kernel 內 strncpy() 的版本
claims.note: Phoronix source returned HTTP 403 (anti-bot); Wayback unreachable. The deep-story ledger corroborates 'six years / 360 patches' via the HN submission title (verified there); the 'first version' superlative is sourced only to Phoronix, so the lede now attributes it visibly (據 Phoronix 報導). Medium-load → accepted-with-flag.

claims.claim_text: Google 示範用 A2A 協定讓 Python agent 與 Go agent 在合約合規任務上跨語言協作，搭配 ADK
claims.evidence: a Python agent extracts contract terms using Gemini and a Go agent validates them against corporate policy … Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is an open standard that enables agents built in any language or framework to interoperate.

claims.claim_text: Ronacher 承認 harness loop 對移植/最佳化有效（自己用它把 MiniJinja 移植到 Go），但擔心長期程式碼會偏向防禦性複雜堆疊而非建立 invariant
claims.evidence: I have used it with success myself to port MiniJinja to Go … too defensive, too complex … avoids strong invariants.

claims.claim_text: Mozilla 與 Cloudflare 等夥伴合作，提出用匿名憑證對抗 bot 又不犧牲隱私的做法，避開綁硬體的 Apple PAT 路線；與同期 Cloudflare 隱私優先協定同一條線
claims.evidence: Working with other web stakeholders, including Cloudflare and other browsers … Anonymous credentials let one party issue you a credential … any site can vouch for users, and where other sites can decide who they trust.
claims.note: Core anonymous-credentials claim verified verbatim. Round-1 flagged '建立在 Privacy Pass 之上' as only weakly supported (source invokes Privacy Pass mainly to describe Apple PAT shortcomings). FIXED: reworded to '與 Privacy Pass 同源' so the lede no longer over-asserts a foundation relationship.

claims.claim_text: Filippo Valsorda 主張漏洞回報不再特殊，因 LLM 把漏洞挖掘平民化，瓶頸從找漏洞移到分流，建議把 LLM 分析掛進 CI
claims.evidence: LLMs are as good as almost any security researcher, and anyone can run them. … the bottleneck now is not finding potential issues but assessing which ones are real. … Triage, rapid remediation, and—as ever—prevention are the job now.

claims.claim_text: 美國後量子行政命令把遷移大限訂在 2030 年
claims.evidence: The order sets a December 31, 2030, deadline for federal agencies to transition their most sensitive systems to post-quantum encryption.

claims.claim_text: Samsung 揭露從 GAA 走向 3D 堆疊 FET，用三層 nanosheet 通道在 42nm 節距內擠出更高電流密度
claims.evidence: from GAA to 3D stacked FET — expanding the transistor into the third dimension; three-layer nanosheet channels within a 42nm pitch; higher current density.
